title.description: Product name shown to the buyer, without the store name

price.description: Current price of the product, with its currency, when every variant has the same price; prices that differ by variant are in variants

availability.description: Whether the product can be bought now, when every variant has the same availability; availability that differs by variant is in variants

stock_quantity.description: Number of items the page says are in stock, when it states one that every variant shares; quantities that differ by variant are in variants

url.description: Canonical URL of the product page

image_url.description: URL of the main product image

brand.description: Brand or manufacturer name of the product

sku.description: The seller's stock keeping unit for the product, when every variant has the same one; per-variant skus are in variants

gtin.description: GS1 trade item number (GTIN-8, -12, -13 or -14) of the product, when every variant has the same one; per-variant gtins are in variants

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number of the product, as the page states it

product_id.description: Product identifier the page states in its own scheme (schema.org productID), other than the sku, gtin or mpn

description.description: Description of the product as the page states it

additional_images.description: Every product image URL the page states for the product, in page order, other than the main image (image_url)

color.description: Colour of the product, as the page states it for the product itself; per-variant colours are in variants

material.description: Material the product is made of, as the page states it

gender.description: Audience the product is meant for: male, female, unisex or kids

condition.description: Condition of the item offered: new, used, refurbished or damaged

rating.description: Average rating of the product on a 0 to 5 scale when the page states its scale (bestRating, worstRating), else as the page states it

review_count.description: Number of reviews the page says the product's rating is based on

variants.description: Every variant the buyer can choose (for example a size or colour), one entry each, with its own identifiers, price, availability and stock quantity

variant_id.description: Identifier the page states for this variant in its own scheme (schema.org productID)

sku.description: The seller's stock keeping unit of this variant

gtin.description: GS1 trade item number (GTIN-8, -12, -13 or -14) of this variant

price.description: Current price of this variant, with its currency

availability.description: Whether this variant can be bought now

stock_quantity.description: Number of items of this variant the page says are in stock, when it states one

name.description: Name of this variant as shown to the buyer
